partitionedTables.name: cwe_catalog
partitionedTables.comment: MITRE Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) catalog, one row per CWE ID (e.g., CWE-79) with name, abstraction level (Class/Base/Variant/Compound), structure, status, and description. Full-catalog snapshot sourced from cwec_latest.xml.zip, refreshed weekly. Canonical dimension joined to NVD CVEs via vulnerability_cwes, to CISA KEV via kev_cwes, and to cyber_threat.owasp_top10 in the vuln_threat_chain view.

partitionedTables.name: vulnerabilities
partitionedTables.comment: NVD CVE 2.0 canonical vulnerability records, one row per CVE, partitioned by publication year and quarter. NVD's own catalog spans 1999-present (~347k CVEs total), but this table's own observedCoverage below is the source of truth for what's actually loaded here — check it rather than assuming the two match. Stores CVSS v2 and v3.1 base scores with their vector strings, plus a CVSS v4.0 base score (no v4.0 vector column), vuln_status, and pipe-delimited CWE IDs. The canonical CVE registry — see kev_catalog for the smaller subset known to be actively exploited, and vulnerability_cwes for the CVE-to-CWE junction.

columns.name: cvss_v31_severity
columns.comment: CVSS v3.1 severity (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

columns.name: cvss_v40_score
columns.comment: CVSS v4.0 base score when present

columns.name: pub_year
columns.comment: Publication year (emitted by transformer from published; drives year partition routing)

columns.name: pub_month
columns.comment: Publication month 1-12 (emitted by transformer from published; drives quarter routing)

partitionedTables.name: vulnerability_cwes
partitionedTables.comment: Junction table of CVE→CWE pairs, materialized from NVD at ingest time. One row per (cve_id, cwe_id) pair. Replaces query-time UNNEST on the pipe-delimited cwe_ids column in vulnerabilities.

columns.name: pub_year
columns.comment: Year from CVE-YYYY-NNN (emitted by transformer; drives year partition routing)

columns.name: pub_month
columns.comment: Month placeholder 1 (emitted by transformer; CVE-year-only routing → Q1)

partitionedTables.name: vulnerability_cpes
partitionedTables.comment: Junction table of CVE→affected CPE (vendor/product/version) pairs, materialized from NVD's configurations[].nodes[].cpeMatch[] array at ingest time. One row per (cve_id, cpe_criteria) pair. Enables per-vendor exploitation analysis (join to kev_catalog on cve_id, aggregate by vendor) that the base vulnerabilities table cannot answer alone. CPE 2.3 format: cpe:2.3:{part}:{vendor}:{product}:{version}:... part = 'a' (application), 'o' (OS), or 'h' (hardware).

columns.name: version
columns.comment: Version string from CPE (may be '*' or literal version)

columns.name: vulnerable
columns.comment: True if this CPE match indicates vulnerable configuration

columns.name: pub_year
columns.comment: Year from CVE-YYYY-NNN (drives year partition routing)

partitionedTables.name: kev_catalog
partitionedTables.comment: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog: one row per CVE known to be actively exploited in the wild, ~1,585 entries. Carries vendor_project, product, vulnerability_name, date_added to KEV, the FCEB remediation due_date, and a known_ransomware_use flag — no CVSS scores are included here. A curated subset of the full NVD catalog in vulnerabilities (join on cve_id); see kev_enriched or kev_cross_threat for KEV joined with NVD CVSS scores and CWE names.

columns.name: due_date
columns.comment: Remediation due date for FCEB agencies (YYYY-MM-DD)

columns.name: known_ransomware_use
columns.comment: Known ransomware campaign use (Known or Unknown)

columns.name: notes_urls
columns.comment: Pipe-delimited URLs split from KEV notes field on semicolon

columns.name: cwes
columns.comment: Pipe-delimited CWE IDs from KEV cwes array (may be empty)

columns.name: catalog_version
columns.comment: Catalog version at ingest time (YYYY.MM.DD) for delta detection

partitionedTables.name: kev_cwes
partitionedTables.comment: Junction table of KEV CVE→CWE pairs, materialized from CISA KEV at ingest time. One row per (cve_id, cwe_id) pair. Replaces query-time UNNEST on the pipe-delimited cwes column in kev_catalog.

partitionedTables.name: osv_vulnerabilities
partitionedTables.comment: OSV (Open Source Vulnerabilities) records for open-source package ecosystems (PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist, Hex, Pub, CRAN), one row per OSV entry (osv_id, e.g. GHSA-xxxx, PYSEC-2021-xxx), partitioned by ecosystem and refreshed weekly. Carries severity type/score, package name and purl, and pipe-delimited alias IDs including CVE IDs where assigned — includes OSV-native entries with no CVE assignment. Not part of vuln_cross_refs, which is sourced solely from GitHub Security Advisories.

columns.name: withdrawn
columns.comment: Withdrawal timestamp if entry was retracted (ISO 8601)

columns.name: aliases
columns.comment: Pipe-delimited alias IDs (CVE IDs, GHSA IDs, etc.)

columns.name: severity_score
columns.comment: CVSS vector string or numeric score

columns.name: ecosystem
columns.comment: Package ecosystem (PyPI, npm, Go, Maven, etc.)

columns.name: package_purl
columns.comment: Package URL (purl) for the affected package

partitionedTables.name: vuln_cross_refs
partitionedTables.comment: Cross-reference mappings from CVE identifiers to external advisory IDs, sourced solely from GitHub Security Advisories (GHSA) via the GraphQL API (single source per the one-table = one-source rule; NVD/OSV cross-refs are derived as SQL views over their own tables). Dedup key is (cve_id, external_id, external_source); external_source is 'ghsa'. APPEND LOG: the incremental delta crawl appends changed advisories each run, so this base table may hold exact-duplicate rows across runs. Query the vuln_cross_refs_unique view for one row per (cve_id, external_id, external_source).

columns.name: external_id
columns.comment: External identifier (GHSA ID, NVD URL slug, etc.)

columns.name: external_source
columns.comment: Source system (ghsa, nvd, cisa, mitre, github, cve)

columns.name: url
columns.comment: URL of the external advisory or reference

body.query: query($first: Int!, $after: String, $updatedSince: DateTime) { securityAdvisories(first: $first, after: $after, updatedSince: $updatedSince, orderBy: {field: UPDATED_AT, direction: ASC}) { pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } nodes { ghsaId publishedAt severity summary identifiers { type value } references { url } } } }

partitionedTables.name: advisories
partitionedTables.comment: CISA cybersecurity advisory metadata, one row per advisory (e.g., AA24-001A, ICSA-24-001-01), partitioned by year. CISA's own feed goes back to 2017, but this table's own observedCoverage below is the source of truth for what's actually loaded here — check it rather than assuming the two match. Refreshed weekly. Carries title, published_date, severity label, pipe-delimited CVE IDs mentioned in the advisory, and a short affected_systems description. Sourced from CISA's official CSAF 2.0 JSON feed (cisagov/CSAF GitHub repo).

columns.name: cve_ids
columns.comment: Pipe-delimited CVE IDs mentioned in the advisory

columns.name: affected_systems
columns.comment: Short description of affected products or systems

operands.comment: Cybersecurity vulnerability data. Canonical vulnerability records from NVD, active exploitation catalog from CISA KEV, CWE taxonomy, and cross-source identifier mappings. Part of the govdata cyber sub-domain.

views.name: vuln_cross_refs_unique
views.comment: Deduplicated CVE↔external-advisory cross-references — the serving layer for vuln_cross_refs. The base vuln_cross_refs table is an APPEND log: the incremental GHSA delta crawl appends only advisories changed since the last watermark each run, so an advisory updated across several runs (and the inclusive updatedSince boundary advisory) contributes the same (cve_id, external_id) mapping more than once. GHSA→CVE mappings are immutable, so those repeats are exact duplicates; this view collapses them to one row per (cve_id, external_id, external_source). Query this view, not the base table, for unique cross-references.
views.sql: SELECT cve_id, external_id, external_source, MIN(url) AS url FROM vuln_cross_refs GROUP BY cve_id, external_id, external_source

views.name: kev_enriched
views.comment: KEV entries enriched with the matching NVD record via LEFT JOIN — one row per KEV entry, adding published/last_modified dates, vuln_status, full description_en, and CVSS v2/v3.1/v4.0 scores. Orphaned KEV entries (no matching NVD record) still appear with NULL NVD columns. For CWE taxonomy names instead of full NVD fields, see kev_cross_threat.
views.sql:
SELECT k.cve_id, k.vendor_project, k.product, k.vulnerability_name,
       k.date_added, k.short_description, k.required_action, k.due_date,
       k.known_ransomware_use, k.notes_urls, k.cwes, k.catalog_version,
       v.published, v.last_modified, v.vuln_status, v.description_en,
       v.cvss_v2_score, v.cvss_v31_score, v.cvss_v31_severity, v.cvss_v40_score
FROM kev_catalog k LEFT JOIN vulnerabilities v ON k.cve_id = v.cve_id

views.name: vuln_cwe_enriched
views.comment: Vulnerability-CWE junction enriched with CWE catalog details via LEFT JOIN. Unresolved CWE IDs still appear with NULL catalog columns.
views.sql:
SELECT vc.cve_id, vc.cwe_id,
       c.name AS cwe_name, c.abstraction, c.status, c.description
FROM vulnerability_cwes vc LEFT JOIN cwe_catalog c ON vc.cwe_id = c.cwe_id

views.name: kev_cwe_enriched
views.comment: KEV CWE references enriched with CWE catalog details via LEFT JOIN. Unresolved CWE IDs still appear with NULL catalog columns.
views.sql:
SELECT kc.cve_id, kc.cwe_id,
       c.name AS cwe_name, c.abstraction, c.status, c.description
FROM kev_cwes kc LEFT JOIN cwe_catalog c ON kc.cwe_id = c.cwe_id

views.name: vuln_threat_chain
views.comment: Cross-domain vulnerability chain: CVE → KEV status → CWE → OWASP Top 10 category. Bridges cyber_vuln and cyber_threat schemas. Filter on cve_id or owasp_rank to navigate the chain. CVE→ATT&CK linkage requires the entity resolution layer (no structural mapping exists in the current data).
views.sql:
SELECT
  v.cve_id,
  v.published,
  v.cvss_v31_score,
  v.cvss_v31_severity,
  CASE WHEN k.cve_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS is_known_exploited,
  k.date_added  AS kev_date_added,
  k.due_date    AS kev_due_date,
  k.known_ransomware_use,
  k.vendor_project,
  vc.cwe_id,
  cw.name       AS cwe_name,
  cw.abstraction AS cwe_abstraction,
  o.rank        AS owasp_rank,
  o.name        AS owasp_category
FROM vulnerabilities v LEFT JOIN kev_catalog       k  ON v.cve_id  = k.cve_id LEFT JOIN vulnerability_cwes vc ON v.cve_id  = vc.cve_id LEFT JOIN cwe_catalog       cw ON vc.cwe_id  = cw.cwe_id LEFT JOIN "cyber_threat"."owasp_top10" o
  ON ('|' || o.cwe_ids || '|') LIKE ('%|' || vc.cwe_id || '|%')

views.name: kev_cross_threat
views.comment: CISA KEV catalog enriched with NVD CVSS v2/v3.1 scores and CWE taxonomy names via LEFT JOIN through vulnerability_cwes and cwe_catalog (not full NVD description/status fields — see kev_enriched for those). One row per CVE in KEV; multiple CWE assignments per CVE are aggregated into a comma-delimited cwe_ids list and a semicolon-delimited cwe_names list.
views.sql:
SELECT
  k.cve_id,
  k.vendor_project,
  k.product,
  k.vulnerability_name,
  k.date_added,
  k.due_date,
  k.known_ransomware_use,
  v.cvss_v31_score,
  v.cvss_v31_severity,
  v.cvss_v2_score,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT vc.cwe_id, ', ') AS cwe_ids,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT cw.name,   '; ') AS cwe_names
FROM kev_catalog k LEFT JOIN vulnerabilities  v  ON k.cve_id  = v.cve_id LEFT JOIN vulnerability_cwes vc ON k.cve_id = vc.cve_id LEFT JOIN cwe_catalog      cw ON vc.cwe_id  = cw.cwe_id GROUP BY k.cve_id, k.vendor_project, k.product, k.vulnerability_name,
         k.date_added, k.due_date, k.known_ransomware_use,
         v.cvss_v31_score, v.cvss_v31_severity, v.cvss_v2_score
